conjecture: Fiberwise group completion ℕ→ℤ of the container tangent structure switches on the full Cartan calculus. Let SPoly_ℤ := Poly_ℤ be the CDC of ℤ-coefficient (virtual) polynomial functors, receiving SPoly via B∘N (N the faithful counting functor, B the coefficient base-change along ι:ℕ↪ℤ). Then (a) the dual-number tangent T=(−)◁D extends to SPoly_ℤ and commutes with completion on the nose (B∘T=T∘B), being base change along the Weil ℤ-algebra ℤ→ℤ[ε]/ε²; (b) SPoly_ℤ is a ROSICKÝ (additive-with-negatives) tangent category — σ=(−)◁φ_{−1} (φ_{−1}:ε↦−ε, i.e. σ(x,v)=(x,−v)) is a negation, the 10-05 killer v+g=0 now solved by g=−v∈ℤ[x,v]; (c) SPoly_ℤ carries a scalar RING object R=ℤ (the line object with its polynomial ring structure) and a compatible action κ_r=(−)◁φ_r (φ_r:ε↦rε, κ(r;(x,v))=(x,rv)) satisfying the ENTIRE Aintablian–Blohmann Definition-1 scalar-ring-object spec (ring-object axioms, κ natural, R-module-in-slice unital/assoc/bilinear-over-+̂-and-+_X/zero, compatibility with the vertical lift λ and canonical flip τ). CONSEQUENTLY, by AB's cited construction (2607.11169), the full Cartan calculus (d, contraction ι_X, Lie derivative L, Lie–Rinehart/Chevalley–Eilenberg assembly; and, ℤ being torsion-free, the cubical CDGA of 2609.05963) DESCENDS to SPoly_ℤ. The obstruction is a single Weil-algebra endomorphism φ_r: the rig ℕ supports it only for r∈ℕ (the surviving rig-scalar fragment of 10-05); the ring ℤ supplies φ_{−1}. Far side of the rig-vs-ring knife.

tree.approach: Pin SPoly_ℤ:=Poly_ℤ (group completion of the additive/fiber structure, which N carries faithfully). Build the completion concretely and show (a) T extends and commutes with B, (b) σ(x,v)=(x,−v) is a negation (Rosický), (c) the scalar ring object R=ℤ + κ satisfy the full AB Def-1 input; descent of d,ι,L then follows from AB's cited construction. children.approach: Lemma 1: B:Poly_ℕ→Poly_ℤ is a strict CDC functor. The flagged risk (group completion ⊥ ◁) is REAL as an abstract universal property but RESOLVED concretely. ◁ is LEFT-additive only: (p+p')◁q=p◁q+p'◁q but h◁(q+q')≠h◁q+h◁q'. Outer slot: (−)◁q is a monoid hom, extends uniquely to the group completion ℤ[x⃗]. Inner slot: NOT additive — the universal property does NOT force h◁(q−q'); the naive free-Ab-enriched completion (forcing ◁ biadditive) is WRONG (collapses y²◁(q−q')). The correct inner extension is literal ℤ[x⃗]-substitution (ℤ[x⃗] closed under composition), restricting to ℕ along the rig hom ι. So the left adjoint handles the outer slot, the ambient RING the inner slot; the two agree on the ℕ-part ⟹ B is a functor. All other CDC data (+,0,×,∂) is rig-operation-defined, preserved by ι.

Poly_ℤ is a CDC over the commutative RING ℤ (BCS 2009: polynomials over any commutative ring form a CDC; axioms use only +,×,d/dx) whose hom commutative monoids (ℤ[x⃗],+) are abelian GROUPS. A CDC with negatives is a Rosický tangent category (Cockett–Cruttwell 2014). Classic background, re-used over ℤ exactly as the proved existence node used it over ℕ (cf. tangent-container-derivative#polyN-is-a-cdc).

Proposition 2: T extends to SPoly_ℤ with B∘T=T∘B on the nose. Tp=p◁D=p+εv·∂p uses only +,×,∂ (rig ops preserved by ι), so ι(Tp)=T(ιp) identically; verified symbolically on y,y²,y+y²,y³,3y⁴+y. Weil reading: T is base change along ℤ→ℤ[ε]/ε² (evaluate at dual numbers), D the representing container.

Proposition 3: SPoly_ℤ is Rosický. σ=(−)◁φ_{−1}, φ_{−1}:ε↦−ε a ℤ-algebra endo (uses −1∈ℤ), i.e. σ(x,v)=(x,−v): a genuine Poly_ℤ morphism, bundle endo over p (base preserved), natural (same computation as κ naturality at r=−1), satisfying (†) +∘⟨σ,id⟩=0∘p fiberwise as (−v)+v=0. The 10-05 killer v+g(x,v)=0 now has the solution g=−v∈ℤ[x,v], available over the ring and impossible over the rig. σ is NOT realized by any genuine container morphism — adding it is what group completion buys.

Theorem 4: R=ℤ (line object with polynomial ring structure +̂,m̂,0̂,1̂,−̂, all ℤ-poly maps; ring axioms = ℤ[a,b,c] identities) and κ_r=(−)◁φ_r (φ_r:ε↦rε, κ(r;(x,v))=(x,rv)) satisfy the ENTIRE AB Definition 1. Verified: ring-object axioms; κ natural wrt generic T(f) (r pulls through the linear Df); R-module-in-slice (unital 1·v=v, assoc r(sv)=(rs)v, bilinear over +̂ and +_X, zero 0·v=0). So AB's scalar-ring-object INPUT is fully present. Descent of d,ι_X,L,CE then by AB's cited construction (2607.11169); ℤ torsion-free ⟹ cubical CDGA (2609.05963) too.

The delicate AB coherences, verified in coordinates on the double tangent T²X=(a,a_1,a_2,a_{12}) with λ(a,v)=(a,0,0,v), τ swapping a_1,a_2. The relevant scalar action on T²X is the INDUCED Tκ_r(a,a_1,a_2,a_{12})=(a,ra_1,a_2,ra_{12}) (= T applied to κ_r), NOT the uniform scaling ρ_r. Then λ∘κ_r=Tκ_r∘λ (both ↦(a,0,0,rv)) and τ∘Tκ_r=κ^outer_r∘τ. KEY SUBTLETY: uniform ρ_r scales the ε_1ε_2 slot by r² and FAILS λ-compat (r²v≠rv); the law holds precisely for Tκ_r because κ_r is ℤ-LINEAR in the tangent direction — this is where ℤ-linearity does real work. Conceptually (Leung 2017): every structure map p,0,+,λ,τ is induced by a Weil-algebra map and φ_r is a ℤ-algebra endo, so the coherences are commuting Weil-algebra squares.
